description: Every value comes from the family's shared preset, the default.json of Horistes (Greek horistes, the boundary commissioner who fixes limits; pronounced ho-RIS-tees), the shared CI repository. Only this repository's own files are set here.

packageRules.description: praetor-managed files: praetorctl adopt ships their updates and praetorctl audit locks them byte for byte

setuptools is pinned twice, as the build requirement in pyproject.toml and in the tool lock that builds without isolation; both move in one pull request (a security update gets one branch per package anyway)
praetor-managed engine: updates arrive in one coordinated adoption pull request

customManagers.description: Trivy vulnerability database pinned by digest
praetor workflow engine commit pin: track the engine default branch

pip-compile.description: Lock files compiled by uv pip compile (make lock): Renovate reads the command from each lock header, bumps the pin in the .in source and runs that command again; the header holds the release age as a duration (P3D), so the command stays valid
